description: This file contains a test class 'StreamReliabilityTests' for testing stream reliability in Orleans-based distributed systems. It includes setup and teardown methods, various test cases for stream operations like restart, silo join/leave, and failure scenarios, as well as utility functions for managing grains and silos.

classes.name: StreamReliabilityTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying stream reliability in Orleans, including scenarios like silo restarts, failures, and joins, with utility methods for managing grains and silos.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the test cluster with Azure storage clustering, silo and client configurators.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Performs cleanup after tests, including deleting Azure queues and disposing of the test cluster.

methods.name: Baseline_StreamRel
methods.description: Sanity check to verify the test configuration is correct.

methods.name: Baseline_StreamRel_RestartSilos
methods.description: Tests restarting all silos and verifies stream operation.

methods.name: SMS_Baseline_StreamRel
methods.description: Runs a baseline stream reliability test with SMS stream provider.

methods.name: AQ_Baseline_StreamRel
methods.description: Runs a baseline stream reliability test with Azure Queue stream provider.

methods.name: Test_AddMany_Consumers
methods.description: Tests adding many consumers to a stream and verifies message delivery.

methods.name: Test_PubSub_MultiConsumerSameGrain
methods.description: Tests multiple consumers on the same grain.

methods.name: Test_PubSub_MultiProducerSameGrain
methods.description: Tests multiple producers on the same grain.

methods.name: Test_PubSub_Unsubscribe
methods.description: Tests unsubscribing from a stream.

methods.name: Test_AllSilosRestart
methods.description: Tests restarting all silos and verifies stream operation.

methods.name: Test_SiloDies_Consumer
methods.description: Tests behavior when a silo containing a consumer is killed.

methods.name: Test_SiloDies_Producer
methods.description: Tests behavior when a silo containing a producer is killed.

methods.name: Test_SiloRestarts_Consumer
methods.description: Tests behavior when a silo containing a consumer is restarted.

methods.name: Test_SiloRestarts_Producer
methods.description: Tests behavior when a silo containing a producer is restarted.

methods.name: Test_SiloJoins
methods.description: Tests adding a new silo to the cluster and verifies stream delivery.

methods.name: RestartAllSilos
methods.description: Utility to restart all silos in the cluster.

methods.name: StopSilo
methods.description: Utility to stop, kill, or restart a specific silo.

methods.name: GetGrain
methods.description: Retrieves a grain reference, optionally on a specific silo.

methods.name: CreateGrainOnSilo
methods.description: Creates a grain instance on a specified silo.

methods.name: CheckConsumerProducerStatus
methods.description: Checks the status of producer and consumer grains.

methods.name: CheckSilosRunning
methods.description: Verifies the number of active silos.

methods.name: CheckGrainCounts
methods.description: Checks the distribution of grains across silos.

methods.name: CheckReceivedCounts
methods.description: Verifies the number of messages received by a consumer grain.

methods.name: CheckConsumerCounts
methods.description: Verifies the number of consumers for a stream.
